title: What the next worker needs to know now
intro: context assembles durable state in authority order and within a line budget, and names everything it excluded. It writes nothing, records nothing, and calls no model.

scenarios.title: With an active task and records behind it
scenarios.explain: Git identity comes first because it is the only section that is not a projection. Everything below it is evidence, and the header says so in as many words.

scenarios.title: With no active task
scenarios.explain: Absence is reported rather than guessed at. A worker who is told there is no active task knows to start one; a worker handed a stale record does not.
